meta: Cook foreign dishes with ingredients from a Vietnamese market with AI, when a recipe sounds great but needs hard-to-find items.

muc.title: Recipes needing hard-to-find items
muc.text: Many foreign recipes sound delicious but get abandoned right away, because they need ingredients that are hard to find at Vietnamese markets.

muc.title: Find replacements at the market
muc.text: Paste the recipe into a chatbot and ask it to replace each hard-to-find ingredient with something from the market or a supermarket nearby.

muc.title: How the taste will differ
muc.text: Ask AI to say how the taste will change after the swaps. That way you know ahead and won't be disappointed.

muc.title: Cook a small batch first
muc.text: The first time, cook a small portion to test. Note what to adjust, then ask AI to fix the recipe for next time.

muc.title: A dish you crave
muc.text: Pick an Italian or Korean dish you like and ask AI to rewrite it with easy-to-buy ingredients.

thu: Pick an Italian or Korean dish you like and ask AI to rewrite it with easy-to-buy ingredients.
